title: Fastest and strongest
description: The run of the worked example on fastest and strongest: a body on a spring with y, v and a against time, lines at their maxima and minima, slow motion on and off, values read off the graphs.

title: The turning pointer
description: The run of the worked example on the turning pointer, y = A·cos(ωt − φ₀): the initial phase φ₀ set in steps of 15°, slow motion on and off, values read off the graph.

title: Potential and Energy Explorer
description: A positive, negative or neutral particle in a field (two plates, the bent field or a gold nucleus): drag its start A, set its kinetic energy there and click any point P; a gauge shows the potential at A and P, bars the potential and kinetic energy at A and P, read qualitatively or with the values, and whether the particle can get to P at all.

title: Charges in Electric Fields
description: A charge in a uniform field (plates side by side or one above the other), near a point charge of any whole multiple of e, in the bent field, or a race of a proton, a neutron, an alpha particle and an electron: particle, start, initial energy and direction, with velocity and force arrows, trace and equipotentials, integrated in real units and played in slow motion.
